en.headline: Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro pop-up at Hysan Place closes on 25 August
en.dek: The limited-time store in Causeway Bay, stocking official apparel and collectables inspired by the films, has been open since late July and ends next Tuesday.
body: The official Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro pop-up store at Hysan Place in Causeway Bay will close on 25 August after a run that began on 24 July.

The temporary shop on the B1 floor offers merchandise drawn from the Harry Potter and Fantastic Beasts films, including apparel such as glow-in-the-dark and colour-changing T-shirts, house-themed pouches, a Honeydukes-inspired shoulder bag and jewellery based on Bertie Bott’s Every Flavour Beans.

According to the organisers, the store operates daily from 11 am to 9 pm at shops B113 and B115, 500 Hennessy Road. The pop-up is presented as a return of the Japanese Mahou Dokoro concept to Hong Kong for the summer period.
Shoppers are advised that the final day is Tuesday 25 August; after that the temporary outlet will not continue at the venue.

zh.headline: 哈利波特Mahou Dokoro期間限定店希慎廣場8月25日結束
zh.dek: 銅鑼灣希慎廣場B1層的官方主題期間限定店自7月24日開業，售賣電影靈感服裝及收藏品，下周二結束營業。
body: 銅鑼灣希慎廣場的哈利波特Mahou Dokoro期間限定店將於8月25日結束，店舖自7月24日開業至今。
位於B1層的臨時店舖售賣以《哈利波特》及《怪獸與它們的產地》電影為靈感的商品，包括夜光及感光變色T恤、學院主題收納包、Honeydukes主題單肩包，以及Bertie Bott’s Every Flavour Beans造型首飾等。
主辦方表示，店舖每日上午11時至晚上9時營業，地址為軒尼詩道500號希慎廣場B113及B115號舖。是次為日本Mahou Dokoro概念重返香港的夏季限定店。
市民如欲參觀，最後一天為8月25日（星期二），其後該臨時店舖將不會繼續於該場地營業。
